content:
**UI Audit Report: EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard (Destination/Retention Gate)**

### 1) LAYOUT
*   **Window Context:** Maximized window (1024x768). A modal dialog is centered over the main application interface.
*   **Modal Dialog (Center):**
    *   **Bounds:** Approx. [180, 145] to [805, 695] (Width ~625px, Height ~550px).
    *   **Header Region:** [180, 145] to [805, 210]. Contains Title and Close (X) button.
    *   **Content Body:**
        *   **Icon Area:** [225, 220] to [280, 320]. Large hourglass icon.
        *   **Text Block 1 (Headline):** [315, 218] to [770, 245].
        *   **Text Block 2 (Body):** [315, 275] to [770, 330].
        *   **Text Block 3 (Sub-headline):** [212, 365] to [520, 385].
    *   **Action Grid (3 Rows):**
        *   **Row 1 (Upsell):** [212, 415] to [760, 475].
        *   **Row 2 (Service):** [212, 505] to [760, 565].
        *   **Row 3 (Quit):** [212, 595] to [760, 655].
*   **Background App (Obscured):**
    *   **Sidebar (Left):** [0, 0] to [270, 920]. Contains navigation items ("Hardware Disk", "SD Card", etc.).
    *   **Main Content (Right):** [270, 0] to [1024, 920]. Header "Select a location...", list of drives, bottom action bar.
    *   **Taskbar (Bottom):** [0, 944] to [1024, 1000].

### 2) TEXT (Verbatim)
*   **Window Title Bar:** `EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free`
*   **Modal Headline:** `Wait! You are at risk of losing data!`
*   **Modal Body:** `More than 50% of permanent data loss occurs because unrecovered files get overwritten by continued computer use.`
    *   *Note:* `permanent data loss` is blue/hyperlinked.
*   **Modal Sub-headline:** `Take the final step now to safely secure your data.`
*   **Action Row 1 (Left):** `Price too high?` | **Icon:** `%` with sparkles/magic effect.
*   **Action Row 1 (Right - Button):** `Get Up to 40% Off`
*   **Action Row 2 (Left):** `Can't find your lost data?`
*   **Action Row 2 (Right - Button):** `Online Service`
*   **Action Row 3 (Left):** `Really want to quit?`
*   **Action Row 3 (Right - Button):** `Quit`
*   **Background Header:** `Select a location to search for lost data`
*   **Background Footer Left:** `Unable to find your hard drive?` + Info Icon
*   **Background Footer Right (Button):** `Search for Lost Data`

### 3) COLOR (Estimated Hex)
*   **Dialog Background:** `#FFFFFF` (White).
*   **Dialog Overlay/Backdrop:** `#2D3E5F` at ~60% opacity (darkening the background app).
*   **Primary Text (Headlines): `#1A1A1A` (Near Black).
*   **Secondary Text (Body): `#555555` (Dark Gray).
*   **Accent Blue (Links/Text Buttons): `#3388FF` (Bright Blue).
*   **Accent Orange (CTA Button):** Gradient from `#FFB84D` (Top) to `#FF9933` (Bottom). Text: `#FFFFFF`.
*   **Row Backgrounds (Alternating/Light):** `#F5F7FA` (Very light blue-gray).
*   **Borders/Dividers:** `#E0E0E0` (Light Gray).

### 4) TYPOGRAPHY
*   **Modal Headline:** Sans-Serif (likely Segoe UI/Arial), ~16-18px, **Bold**.
*   **Modal Body:** Sans-Serif, ~13-14px, Regular.
*   **Action Row Text (Left):** Sans-Serif, ~14px, Regular/Dark.
*   **Button Text (Right):** Sans-Serif, ~13-14px, **Bold** (Orange button), Regular (Blue text buttons).
*   **App Header:** Sans-Serif, ~20px, Regular.

### 5) SPACING & SIZING
*   **Dialog Padding:** ~30-40px internal margin.
*   **Row Height (Actions):** ~60px per row.
*   **Button Size (Orange CTA):** Width ~160px, Height ~36px. Border Radius: ~4-6px.
*   **Button Size (Blue Outline/Text):** Width ~140px, Height ~36px.
*   **Gutter between Rows:** ~15-20px.
*   **Icon Size (Hourglass):** ~64x64px.
*   **Close Button (X):** ~24x24px click area, icon ~12x12px.

### 6) CONTROLS & STATES
*   **Modal Dialog:**
    *   **Close Button (Top Right):** State: Normal (Hover/Clickable).
    *   **Hyperlink:** `permanent data loss`. State: Normal.
    *   **Button: `Get Up to 40% Off`:** State: **Enabled**, Primary Action (Solid Fill).
    *   **Button: `Online Service`:** State: **Enabled**, Secondary Action (Light Blue background or Ghost style).
    *   **Button: `Quit`:** State: **Enabled**, Tertiary/Destructive action style (Light Blue background).
*   **Background App (Partially Visible):**
    *   **Sidebar Items:** List items. "Hardware Disk" appears selected (blue left border/highlight).
    *   **Main Button: `Search for Lost Data`:** State: **Enabled** (Solid Blue).

### 7) ICONOGRAPHY
*   **Style:** Flat, Vector-based, slightly rounded corners.
*   **Hourglass (Modal):** Filled style. Blue gradient top/bottom, clear center.
*   **Percentage/Magic Icon:** Pink/Magenta fill (`#FF4081` approx), white symbol.
*   **Close (X):** Thin outline stroke (~1.5px).
*   **Sidebar Icons:** Filled/Glyph style (Hardware disk, SD card, tools).
*   **Info Icon (Footer):** Circle with 'i', outline style.

### 8) STATE
*   **Page State:** **Retention / Interruption Gate (Exit Intent / Upsell)**.
*   **Context:** The user is likely attempting to close the application or proceed without saving/recovering, triggering this "Risk of losing data" warning to upsell the Pro version or offer services.
*   **Motion Cues:** None visible in static capture, but the modal implies an interruption of the standard workflow.

### Specific Focus Items Check:
*   **Local/Cloud Tabs:** Not visible (obscured by modal or not on this specific screen step).
*   **Drive Rows:** Obscured by modal.
*   **Choose Folder Row:** Obscured by modal.
*   **Enable-file-repair toggle:** Obscured by modal.
*   **Save Button:** Obscured by modal.
*   **Warnings:** The entire modal acts as a warning/gate.
*   **Retention/Upsell Gate:**
    *   **Headline:** "Wait! You are at risk of losing data!"
    *   **Body:** "More than 50% of permanent data loss occurs..."
    *   **Buttons:** "Get Up to 40% Off", "Online Service", "Quit".
    *   **X Position:** Top Right of modal [770, 170].
*   **Insufficient Space Gate:** Not present; this is a general retention/upsell gate.
